# DoorOpenerBruh

> DoorOpenerBruh is an automatic proximity-based door and gate opener and closer for valheim. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Proximity detection and door animation triggering**: Proximity detection and door animation triggering.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal door watchers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal door watchers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/DoorOpenerBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
